# Pixel Task List

A simple offline task list with a pixel-inspired dark theme. All data is kept in memory and resets on page reload.

## Features

- Add tasks via input or Enter key
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored
- Toggle completion with checkboxes
- Delete tasks with × buttons
- Live counts: total tasks and incomplete tasks
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px width

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Files

- `index.html` – Structure
- `style.css` – Styling
- `script.js` – Logic
